short.q: Explain the difference between a raga and a tala.
short.model: A raga is the melodic framework of notes and rules; a tala is the repeating rhythmic cycle.

short.q: Describe the structure of a typical gamelan piece.
short.model: A repeating cycle marked by gongs (colotomic), with interlocking parts on metallophones and heterophonic decoration of a core melody.
Fast syncopated 2/4 rhythm played by a batucada of surdo, caixa and tamborim, often with call and response.

short.q: Explain why polyrhythm is important in West African music.
short.model: It builds a rich texture from interlocking drum parts, over which the master drummer improvises for dancers.

short.q: Describe how a fusion piece can combine two traditions.
short.model: It can use traditional instruments of each tradition, rhythms from one with melodies from the other, and electronic beats, e.g. Irish fiddle with African drumming.
